main_measure.name: mean unusual 48-bar move on cases, pooled over coins
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and positive slope; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of unusual move on forecast at signal bar

decided_by: Mean unusual move positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases, and the slope on the forecast is positive.
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise >= 2 from its lowest level since the last bet, reset to 0 when flat) in each cell of the window's 48-bar grid counted from its first row, with its 48-bar return inside the window; the drift is the coin's mean 48-bar return on that grid over all its windows; the situation is any negative 24-bar return on the long side.
